_note: Attacks as key poses, played by tools/creatures/strikes.py (see tools/creatures/README.md, Attacks). styles: an attack style's keys (when each pose is reached: a share of the clip, or the hit moment plus or minus one; then the pose; then how it is arrived at: out brakes into it, in speeds into it, inout both, linear neither) and its poses. A pose's numbers are turns in radians on top of the animal's stance: rear (nose up on the hind feet), dip (nose down on the front feet), pitch, turn (to its left) and roll of the whole body; move [right, forward, up] in shoulder heights; squash, stretch and swell of the whole body (shares); bones {bone: [x, y, z]} (x swings a bone forward or up, y twists it, z turns it sideways; a jaw's x is in the animal's own gapes); legs {fl.R: [upper, lower, foot, splay]}; wings [shoulder, elbow, hand, sweep, twist]; tail [curl, swing]; trunk [curl, swing]; ears [back, out]; scale {bone: [x, y, z]}; shift {bone: [x, y, z]} in shoulder heights along the bone's own axes. like and times build a pose on another. lag: how far behind the body a loose part runs (a share of the clip; a tail's bones each one more). wobble: a loose part springing to a stop after the hit [axis, radians, swings, how fast it dies]. fill: a lunge, whose own steps forward are let out as far as the animal's reach allows (the reach rule), whatever its build. mirror: led by the other side. limits: the reach rule (strikes.py): the share of its reach a clip may carry an animal's front at the hit and at most, a flier's allowance on top, how far a shooter may lean in and how far any back end may push back (field tiles). standard: what a clip must show to read in a fight (strike_check.py): how much its outline changes from the game's camera, from behind and from the front, as a share of its outline: in its wind-up against how it stood, and in its blow against its wind-up. roster: the animals whose attacks are played from here. bodies: a body plan's own version of a style (snakes, seals, birds). animals: an animal's own changes on top.
